errors.evidence: The chart shows only four models (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT), which are all identified in the legend. There is no fifth, unidentified model. The orange bar corresponds to CoD.

errors.text_span: измерени върху четири различни benchmark-а за четири различни LRM
errors.evidence: This information is taken from the paper's caption, not from the visual elements of the chart itself. The description should only include what is visible in the figure.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос по дъното на диаграмата представя петте модели
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not represent five models; it displays bars corresponding to four models. The primary organization of the axis is into two groups of bars: one for 'Accuracy (%)' and one for 'Token Count'.

errors.text_span: подредени в азбучен ред според техните имена
errors.evidence: The models (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT) are not arranged in alphabetical order within the groups.

errors.text_span: Всяка категория има два стълба – един за точност и един за брой токените
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the chart's structure. The chart is not grouped by category (model) with two bars each. Instead, it has two large groups based on the metric (Accuracy and Token Count), with each group containing four bars, one for each model.
This incorrectly assigns the orange color to a non-existent 'remaining' model. The legend clearly shows that orange corresponds to the 'CoD' model.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са разположени в групи по два, като всяка група съответства на един модел
errors.evidence: This is a major misrepresentation of the chart's structure. The bars are arranged in two large groups of four, one for each metric (Accuracy and Token Count), not in groups of two per model.

errors.text_span: The bar chart, titled "Accuracy (%)" and labeled "Token Count" on the secondary y-axis,
errors.evidence: The figure shows two separate bar charts placed side-by-side, not a single chart with a secondary y-axis. "Accuracy (%)" is the title of the left chart, and "Token Count" is the title of the right chart.
The description swaps the accuracy values for two of the methods. The chart shows CoD (orange bar) has an accuracy of 80.89%, and CoUT (green bar) has an accuracy of 88.40%.

errors.text_span: The bars are sorted in descending order of accuracy on the left side
errors.evidence: The bars in the 'Accuracy (%)' chart are not sorted in descending order. The values from left to right are 91.19, 80.89, 88.50, and 88.40.

errors.text_span: Jede Methode hat zwei Balken: der linke Balken repräsentiert die Genauigkeit, der rechte die Tokenanzahl.
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly describes the structure of the chart. The chart does not show two adjacent bars (left for accuracy, right for token count) for each method. Instead, it presents two separate plots side-by-side: the first plot on the left contains four bars showing the 'Accuracy' for all four methods, and the second plot on the right contains four bars showing the 'Token Count' for the same four methods.
